title: Tech debt eats 20–40% of your tech estate's value
takeaways: Tech debt equals 20–40% of tech estate value (McKinsey).
10–20% of new-product budget goes to fixing debt.
About 70% of Indian leaders say legacy debt is slow to fix.
Accounting for debt can lift AI returns by 29% (IBM).
Benchmark: about 15% of IT budget for remediation.
source_note: Sources: McKinsey; Bain 2026; IBM IBV 2025; Accenture 2024
